title: Luceras Game Mesh
heading: Luceras: the game mesh
lede: Stage 6 of 11. The approved sculpt is about 300,000 triangles; the version that ships to phones is 11,478. One question: any visible loss? Each picture puts the sculpt on the left and the game mesh on the right. Fine skin detail is carried by a baked texture, so it still shows. Approve, or say what got lost and in which view.
fallback: Approvals cannot be saved from this view; reply in chat.
compositeEmpty: Confirm closes the game mesh; the surface stage (fur, color, horn and claw look) starts next.
confirmed: Confirmed; the surface stage starts next.

fold.title: Decided by the pipeline owner
fold.text: Six Codex passes. Rebuilding the surface as a new mesh (passes 1 to 4) kept the overall shape but every local repair left seams or dark marks; reducing the sculpt directly (pass 5) kept its own surface and fixed the ears, tail root and paws at once; pass 6 removed two small faults. Budgets: 11,478 triangles (limit 12,000), 40 joints, at most 4 bone influences per point, 2 materials, one 1024 texture set. Codex time about 3.8 hours, about 1.3M tokens.

judge: Sprite size and full body: the same creature?
Head, paws: anything missing or changed?

mesh.note: Known: the top edge of the horns is slightly polygonal at the closest camera; the whiskers are off the mesh until the surface stage decides how they are drawn.
